title: Excalibur | Undermod Support
description: A non official compatibility pack between Excalibur and Undermod.
body:
This Texture pack Re textures all the Blocks and Gui's from the Undermod mod to better fit Excalibur.

See Gallery for the the textures.

The only things i didnt do were the black mushroom, Rats and Leeches as i felt the mobs fit and i couldn't do 3D textures for the mushroom. 

 

Best Used with Excalibur

And Requires Undermod

Enjoy.
